# Ayurveda & Asana Yoga — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> Holistic iPhone and iPad platform uniting classical Ayurvedic six-taste (Shad Rasa) and dosha-aware meal planning (crosswalked to measured USDA FoodData Central nutrients) with 850+ illustrated yoga postures and 60 pranayama/restorative practices.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/ayurveda-asana-yoga-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/ayurveda-asana-yoga-docs/
- **Platforms**: iOS 18+, iPadOS 18+
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- Provenance-preserving crosswalk between traditional Ayurvedic food classifications (Shad Rasa / dosha context) and measured USDA FoodData Central nutrients.
- Offline-capable library of 850+ illustrated yoga postures (asanas) and 60 guided pranayama breath and restorative sessions.
- Dual knowledge portals at ayurveda-asana-yoga.wise-eating.com and ayurveda.arte-soft.com.

## Canonical Web Hubs
- [Primary Website](https://ayurveda-asana-yoga.wise-eating.com/): Official product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Arte Soft Portal](https://ayurveda.arte-soft.com/): Expanded multilingual guides, comparisons, and technical references.
- [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ayurveda-asana-yoga/id6800370073): Official App Store listing by Arte Soft EOOD.
- [Side-by-Side Comparisons](https://ayurveda-asana-yoga.wise-eating.com/compare): Structured HTML & GFM comparison matrices.
- [Guides & Workflows](https://ayurveda-asana-yoga.wise-eating.com/guides): Step-by-step operational guides.
- [Full Site LLM Reference](https://ayurveda-asana-yoga.wise-eating.com/llms-full.txt): Complete GFM Markdown table export.
